standard.summary: 温度闭环：超过目标温度自动降低有效占空比
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Closed-loop temperature: lowers the effective duty cycle automatically above the target
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 温度闭环：超过目标温度自动降低有效占空比，降温后自动恢复速度。留空关闭；与上方手动占空比同设时取更低者

advanced_en.principle: Temperature closed loop: above the target temperature the effective duty cycle is lowered automatically, and speed recovers once temperatures drop. Empty disables it; when set together with the manual duty cycle above, the lower of the two wins.
